{{Quote|Bricka was kind enough to let me know you'd be here, Rook. Now I can thank you personally for selling my weapons to Boss Caylagos.|Shon Ti'Ja|<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />}}
'''Shon Ti'Ja''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]], was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he owned an assortment of creatings&mdash;a [[sloat]], a snake-like creation; several [[Saberfish/Legends|saberfish]] in a pit of water; and at least two other creatures. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] were on Wielu, Ti'Ja used his creatures to defeat them, though he failed and surrendered.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />
